watchouts: The trade-in pays $1,000 / $700 / $600 / $550 / $500 by tier, whatever brand the trade-in is.
Even the $500 floor beats the $200 no-trade credit, so any qualifying trade-in wins. The two are not combinable — the line gets one or the other.
The iPhone Duo has its own trade-in list: 14 newer phones on it (such as the iPhone 18 Pro, Pixel 11 and Galaxy Z Flip 8) are taken only on this deal, not on the other upgrade trade-in deals.
Not available through Upgrade Anytime — the current phone must be paid off.
Not a Diamond member? An iPhone Duo upgrade gets the $200 no-trade credit only — there is no trade-in deal on it.
Credit is spread over 36 monthly bill credits — cancel the line or pay the phone off early and the remaining credits are forfeited.
The credit can never exceed the retail price of the phone being bought.
Not combinable with any other device offer.
